description: Five-phase permanent-magnet synchronous machine with the orthogonal five-axis Clarke treatment: phase voltages V_A..V_E project onto the fundamental (alpha/beta) plane and the second-harmonic (z1/z2) plane (factor 2/5, amplitude-invariant, peak per-phase convention matching PmsmDq's 2/3). The alpha/beta plane integrates the standard dq PMSM equations (Ld, Lq, Rs, Lambda, Poles); the z1/z2 axes integrate their own R/L leakage pairs (unexcited by the sinusoidal EMF); the common-mode (zs) axis is not integrated because the open-star machine takes no common-mode current (Leg5ph removes the common mode per substep). Emits five phase currents, electromechanical torque (N/2 = 5/2 peak-phase power convention), electrical angle, and air-gap power. When OpenGates is driven >= 0.5 (by a Plant.Fault.Point node) all current axes enter the freewheel collapse (tau = 2 ms, same twin convention as PmsmDq). SIMPLIFICATIONS WITH PROVENANCE: z-plane rotor/mutual coupling neglected (true only for ideal sinusoidal-distributed 5-phase with no 3rd-harmonic EMF), star-point displacement not modeled, Lz is a calibration-gap inductance. See PROVENANCE.md in this folder.

inputPorts.name: Omega_Elec
inputPorts.description: Electrical rotor speed, rad/s, from Plant.Shaft.* nodes.

inputPorts.name: OpenGates
inputPorts.description: >=0.5 routes the machine into the open-circuit freewheel collapse (gate-reset / power-cut / PWM gate-off); <0.5 = live. Defaults to 0 when unconnected.

outputPorts.name: Iz1
outputPorts.description: z1-axis current (second orthogonal plane), A. Truth tap for the 5-phase axes; stays ~0 for balanced sinusoidal drive.

outputPorts.name: Iz2
outputPorts.description: z2-axis current (second orthogonal plane), A. Truth tap.

outputPorts.name: P_Elec
outputPorts.description: Electrical air-gap power drawn from/into the winding, W (positive = absorbed).

Lz.description: z1/z2-plane axis inductance (self leakage of the second harmonic plane), H. Calibration gap: no recorded 5-phase bench evidence for this pack yet.

Lambda.description: PM flux linkage per phase, Wb (peak convention).

Poles.description: Pole PAIRS (machine-family convention; the physical pole count is 2x).
